reasons: Datadog redis.expires counts keys that have an expiration set, but the candidate uses redis.db.keys, which counts all keys in a db. That is a different quantity.

The candidate drops the $host template variable (tag prefix host, default *), which should become a host matcher. The dataset observes only redis_version as a label for redis.db.keys, so no host label is confirmed, and the filter cannot be expressed safely.
No OTel metric in the provided definitions measures keys with expiration set, so the correct outcome is blocked with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING rather than translated.
The candidate also has no metric-type or label-based way to reproduce the expires series, so the translation should not be emitted.
